items.caption: Seal-script form of 言, the speech-related component in the traditional analysis of 誰.
items.alt: A black seal-script form identified as 言, on a white background.
items.selection_reason: It illustrates the component that the traditional analysis associates with speech meaning; this seal-script rendering does not show the reported bronze forms.

items.caption: Seal-script form of 隹, the element assigned a sound role in the traditional analysis of 誰.
items.alt: A black seal-script form identified as 隹, on a white background.
items.selection_reason: It illustrates the graph assigned a phonetic role in the traditional analysis. The graphic example alone does not establish that role or the proposed ancient sound connection.

limitations.text: These seal-script component renderings do not show the reported bronze graph with 言 and 隹 or the inscription read with bare 隹 as 誰. No verified image of those bronze forms is available for display here, so their shapes and relationship cannot be illustrated directly.
